chapter_note: The chapter preserves a short cosmological definition of Love (as the Father of Greatness) and Hate (as Death/Darkness mechanics), with a later ecclesial-Christian expansion: paragraph 3 pivots to the holy church, the apostle, and an explicit Gospel-style citation (Jn 15:13 / Jn 1 noted in apparatus), indicating later overlay. The opening of ¶1 and the attribution in ¶4 are hagiographic frame wrapping otherwise older teaching.

paragraphs.temporal_note: Formulaic dialogue frame (“Once again he speaks to his disciples”) introducing a Q&A; this is compiling-community apparatus rather than impersonal cosmological exposition.

paragraphs.core_text: ⟨p.156⟩Love is the Father of Greatness, who dwells in his glorious land. The entirety of the divine has been revealed [there]in! These two are a single living body, the Father and his love; because he has given himself for every thing, as he exists in his aeons. Indeed, due to this, they called the Father, the Lord of the totality, 'love'. For he gave the victory to his aeons and his limbs.
paragraphs.temporal_note: System-internal identification (Love ↔ Father of Greatness) and aeonic/limb cosmology in an expository voice; no citation formulas or institutional address.

Editorial application to the holy church and the apostle, plus explicit written/citation formula (“So is it written…”) and a Gospel-like saying (“no love greater… give himself to death”), marking NT-mediated Christian overlay and ecclesial extension.

paragraphs.core_text: What, conversely, is Hate? Hate is the first Death that welled up. It revealed the land of Darkness. This one called 'hate', because it has ruined all its perdition's offspring; it sinned even against a power foreign to it, and ruined it. Due to this they shall call it 'hated'; for it has caused destruction, both wounding in flesh, and what is not its own.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed hagiographic attribution: “Once again he speaks:” (dialogue-frame marker).
paragraphs.temporal_note: After stripping the speaker-attribution frame, the remaining content is impersonal cosmological mechanics (Hate/Death as primal emergence revealing Darkness), consistent with the older system layer.

paragraphs.core_text: Today again it causes wounding and destruction in all flesh. It kills them all with diverse deaths; these that are displayed today in every thing, in every type. Even the Cross of Light, the Living Soul, likewise too it ruins and kills them; as it did at the start. Indeed, due to this have they called it 'hated', this one from the hated; the envy from the envy; the Devil from the Devil; the bad that came about from the bad.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the same cosmological agent-mechanics (Hate/Death attacking flesh and the Cross of Light/Living Soul). The repeated “today” reads as mixture-time description rather than institutional exhortation; no church/prescriptive pivot.
